messages:
customer-tenant-admin: Hey team — after our SSO -> SCIM migration some embed requests started returning 403s. Console shows \"invalid_api_key\" and customers are blocked. Happens for service-account tokens only, user tokens are fine. Anyone seen this?
support-bot: Thanks for the report — can you paste a failing request-id or a short repro (curl) and a recent timestamp?
jordan: pinging in — saw a similar pattern last month. Usually entitlement gating gets surfaced as 403 but sometimes the surface error is the generic invalid key. Can you share request-id?
customer-tenant-admin: request-id: rq_20263135789012_01. Repro curl: 
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer svc-xxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-compact-1","input":"hello"}'
```
Response body: `\{"error\":\"invalid_api_key\"}` and status 403. Logs show: `entitlement_check: failed - missing_sku: embeddings`
jordan: ok that log line is key — entitlement failed for the service account's tenant. The token is valid but the tenant mapping after SSO migration didn't carry the billing SKU to the service account role. Entitlement check short-circuits and we currently map that to a generic invalid_api_key 403 for legacy clients.
anya: that's the masking we discussed. We need to avoid sending invalid_key for plan/sku failures. Could we add a distinct error code like `plan_entitlement_denied` (still 403) so clients and our support flows can distinguish?
ops-sre: quick mitigation: we can force a tenant entitlement cache flush for the tenant id tied to svc-xxxx. I can run a one-off resync now. Jordan — need tenant id?
jordan: tenant is t-4792-prod. If you flush/resync the entitlement cache that should restore correct SKU mapping for the service-account. Also add note: we saw a race where SCIM account comes before billing sync, TTL = 10m so some requests get the masked response.
ops-sre: running resync... ✳️
ops-sre: resync complete for t-4792-prod at 2026-03-17T14:55Z. Can you retry?
customer-tenant-admin: retried right after — same curl now returns 200 and embeddings payload. Thanks!
jordan: root cause summary for the ticket: SSO/SCIM migration created the service-account identity before billing SKU sync. Entitlement cache TTL allowed a window where the entitlement check returned empty, which our error mapping turned into `invalid_api_key` 403. Fixes: 1) short-term: resync/flush entitlement cache on migration (ops). 2) medium: change error surface to include plan-specific 403 code and message so support + clients can see plan vs auth. 3) long-term: add blocking validation in migration workflow to ensure billing SKU present before first token acceptance or return explicit plan-blocked error from gateway.
anya: I'll file a small PR to change mapping + add new error code `plan_entitled_required` and update SDK docs to recommend checking 403 subtype. Jordan — can you add a repro test in support matrix and the ticket with the curl and logs?
jordan: will add test and update the support runbook. Also recommending we instrument how often entitlements return empty during migrations and alert if >1% failures in a 5m window.
eng-plat: noted — also adding a console UI quick-link for admins to force resync entitlement for a tenant (requires ops approval) so support can self-serve.
customer-tenant-admin: huge help, thanks everyone. Can we notify affected users and add a blurb in release notes about this migration caveat?
jordan: yes — I'll prepare the customer notification draft and CC you for review.
ops-sre: action items: resync done, will monitor for 30m.
anya: PR link will be in the ticket (internal) and I'll add unit tests for mapping.
customer-tenant-admin: thanks :thumbsup:
